notes.title: Demo Update 2025/8/27: 16 Languages & WASD Controls!
notes.content: [p]Yes, this is a [b]Demo update[/b], but I made it better for everyone who wants to try it out![/p][p]Here’s what’s new in the [b]latest demo build[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]🌍 [b]16 languages supported[/b] – play the demo in your own language![/p][/*][*][p]🐞 [b]Bug fixes & logic improvements[/b] – smoother, cleaner gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]🎮 [b]WASD movement[/b] – comfy classic controls added to the demo![/p][/*][/list][p]This update is all about making the [b]demo experience[/b] more enjoyable and accessible. 🚀[/p]
